title: [frontend] Botón Descargar Excel (template/actual) en UniversoTab
goal: Add a 'Descargar Excel' button + valores-actuales/template toggle to UniversoTab (mirroring JAA-628's ParamsExcelToolbar pattern), backed by a new downloadUniversoExcel(pais, template) client fn hitting GET /weighting/params/{pais}/universo/export.xlsx, with a mock-server contract route so it's testable without the JAA-789 real backend.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: UniversoTab renders a 'Descargar Excel' button (data-testid=download-excel-btn) next to the existing 'Actualizar desde Excel' button, plus a toggle (data-testid=download-template-toggle) for valores actuales vs template vacío.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest UniversoTab.test.tsx renders both buttons + toggle

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Clicking Descargar Excel calls downloadUniversoExcel(pais, template) which GETs /weighting/params/{pais}/universo/export.xlsx as a blob with ?template reflecting the toggle state, and triggers a browser download (anchor-click pattern, same as downloadParamsExcel/downloadFormato4).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest mocks api.get and asserts the URL/params + that a download is triggered (createObjectURL/anchor click called)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: mock-server serves GET /weighting/params/:pais/universo/export.xlsx (and ?template=true) returning a valid minimal xlsx with columns Categoria,Expresion,Jerarquia,Secuencia,Marginales + at least one period column, reusing the existing universo fixture rows for the non-template case.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/weighting/params/chile/universo/export.xlsx (and ?template=true) returns 200 with an xlsx content-type/body

acceptance_criteria.criterion: npm run test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b && npm run build all green.

tasks.desc: Add downloadUniversoExcel(pais, template) to src/modules/pesaje/params/api.ts (blob GET + anchor-click, same pattern as downloadParamsExcel).
Add 'Descargar Excel' button + template toggle to UniversoTab.tsx next to 'Actualizar desde Excel'.
Add mock-server route for GET /weighting/params/:pais/universo/export.xlsx (+ ?template=true) generating a minimal valid xlsx from the universo fixture.
Write/extend UniversoTab test coverage for ac1/ac2.
Commit, push, PR to develop with auto-complete armed.

out_of_scope: The real ms-process-api export.xlsx endpoint (JAA-789, separate repo/session). Changes to the existing upload wizard (JAA-583) or publish flow.
